interpretation: Timing is per release: the data does not say when within a release interval a change happened.
Trails join release positions in order; the lines between them are not observed paths.
Releases with changes_published false had no added, removed or data_changed rows published by Overture; their added and removed counts are not evidence of no change.
A spike can reflect a source or schema change rather than real-world change.
Where a release's changelog is missing (June 2025), the next changelog is relative to a release not listed here: records first seen there without an added row are counted in first_seen_without_added.
Positions before 2026-03-18.0 are stored as 32-bit floats (about 0.2 m here); min_step_m is set above that.
method: Overture places changelogs, one per release, filtered to the AOI. Added and removed come from the changelog's change type. A position change is a record whose changelog position differs from its last-seen position (latest earlier changelog that lists it) by at least min_step_m, whatever its change type. Position is the changelog bbox centre; for removed records, the last position.
